title: Generated sweep IDs can exceed or saturate their configured range
findings_note: Obfuscator/DataGenerator.cs:280 outer-group IDs clamp at TotalRangeMax, so groups past the range share one ID; Obfuscator/DataGenerator.cs:101 inner-step IDs ignore TotalRangeMax and type bounds
boundary: Not in this slice: changing how inner-step indexes are derived, and any new generatedIdMode.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Outer-group IDs clamp at TotalRangeMax (DataGenerator.NextSequenceValue), so every group past the range shares one ID. Inner-step IDs are TotalRangeMin plus the innermost value index and ignore TotalRangeMax. All outer-group columns share one _sequenceCounter, so with two or more such columns each column's IDs skip values.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: ValidateConfig rejects an outer-group column whose range holds fewer IDs than the number of distinct outer groups (the product of the outer axes' value counts; 1 with a single axis). It rejects an inner-step column whose range holds fewer IDs than the innermost axis has values. Both are checked in sweep and max mode, and a range that fits exactly is accepted. With two outer-group columns, each column counts TotalRangeMin, TotalRangeMin+1, ... over the groups.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: In ValidateConfig, after the sweep axis checks, compute the number of outer groups and the innermost value count. Reject any generatedIdMode column where TotalRangeMin + needed - 1 > TotalRangeMax, naming the column, the IDs needed, and the range. In DataGenerator, give each outer-group column its own counter (keyed by column name) and drop the clamp. Document the range requirement in both READMEs next to the other validation rules.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Run the new validation and per-column counter tests, the existing generator tests, and confirm the golden sweep fixture still matches byte for byte. Then dotnet test Obfuscator.slnx and scripts/test-local.sh.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Do not regenerate or edit the committed golden fixture.
